name: check_room
description: Check whether a room is available for a requested time interval. Give start, end, and now as whole minutes since midnight in the inclusive range 0-1440; 1440 represents midnight at the end of the day. Include whether the room is blocked and every existing booking using the same minute units. This tool only checks availability; it does not save, create, or modify a booking.

start.title: Start time
start.description: Requested start as whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440.

end.title: End time
end.description: Requested end as whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440.

now.title: Current time
now.description: Current time as whole minutes since midnight, from 0 to 1440.

bookings.title: Existing bookings
bookings.description: Existing booking intervals, which may be an empty list.

start.description: Booking start in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Booking end in whole minutes since midnight.
